description: Stateful wallet-change monitor: first call stores a baseline for (id, address); later calls with the same id return the change since your previous call (balance delta in wei, outgoing-tx delta, blocks/seconds elapsed). Built for repeat polling of watchlists and alerts. Price: $0.01 per call in USDC on Base (eip155:8453), paid with x402 in params._meta["x402/payment"]. HTTP: GET https://api.firstmention.uk/s/walletprofile/monitor

id.description: Your opaque key. Reuse it to get the diff for this address (letters, digits, _ . : -, max 120 chars).

name: walletprofile__monitor
